questions: What belongs in the canon?
If something enters the canon, does that make it true?
What is a revolution?
When a revolution ends, does everything go back to where it started?
What is a restoration?
After the restoration, is everything exactly as it was before?
What is memory?
If memory is erased, does the past disappear?
What is an archive?
If the archive is deleted, is the past gone?
What is a republic?
When the Republic falls, does the Empire take over?
What is a party?
If the party breaks up, who is left in charge?
What is a colony?
If the colony loses the queen, does it collapse?
What is conversion?
After the conversion, is the original still there?
What is a period?
If the period is late, does it change what comes next?
What is evidence?
If the evidence is excluded, does the story change?
What is an agent?
If the agent stops acting, does anything still change?
What is corruption?
If the corruption is removed, does the original return?
What is a settlement?
When a settlement is made, is the dispute over?
What is transmission?
If the transmission fails, does anything still get through?
